title: Spider metatarsus
concept: The lower leg and claw of a giant spider.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single long thin straight tapered rod sculpture, 1.3 m long, 0.14 m thick at the left end tapering to a single small hooked black point at the right end, a small collar at the left end, smooth satin dark brown-black lacquer with subtle reddish-brown mottling. Side view, lying horizontally, both ends fully in frame. A single object alone, nothing else, generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 800 triangles, 1K maps. Eight instances; the claw is the foot.
